svg.title: Universal Programmatic Source-to-Infographic & Motion Workflow Diagram
svg.desc: A three-tier architectural blueprint uniting the 5-stage SymSpec compiler and 4-round Recursive Self-Improvement loop with the three programmatic engines (Milton 2.5D, Motion Atlas Wada 348, Orpheum Double Operad) and the grounded source document workflow DAG.

g.text: COMBINED PROGRAMMATIC WORKFLOW DIAGRAM · SOURCE DOCUMENT → RSI LOOP → MULTI-CHROME ARTIFACTS
Active Source: Talent Accelerator Program (TAP) (fnv1a:a48a83f3) · 52/52 Conservation Gates PASS (H1–H8 · G01–G20 · P1–P8)
TIER I · PROGRAMMATIC COMPILER & CLOSED-LOOP RECURSIVE SELF-IMPROVEMENT (RSI MECHANISM)
Sheaf Cohomology δ⁰ = 0 · Deterministic Fixpoint in ≤ 3 Rounds
Bass · Koolhaas · Wada · Sheaf · Milton · Orpheum
↺ RECURSIVE SELF-IMPROVEMENT FEEDBACK LOOP (R0: 42% → R1: 71% → R2: 90% → R3: 100% LOCK-IN)
